name: hardware-example
author: OneKey
description: OneKey Hardware SDK Electron BLE example

scripts.dev-electron-web: cross-env NODE_ENV=development yarn build:main && cd ../expo-example && yarn dev:electron-web
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "yarn dev:electron" "cross-env TRANSFORM_REGENERATOR_DISABLED=true BROWSER=none yarn dev-electron-web"
scripts.make:mac: yarn rebuild:deps && yarn clean:build && yarn build-electron-web && electron-builder build --mac --config electron-builder.config.js --publish always
scripts.make:win: yarn rebuild:deps && yarn clean:build && yarn build-electron-web && electron-builder build --win --config electron-builder.config.js --publish always
